description: Find tickets, build two table views and capture the final key.

activities.prompt: Find BSIT tickets. Show five rows per page, sort student names A–Z, and submit page 1.
Find North campus business students. Use global search for the program and a column filter for campus. Put higher years first, then names A–Z. Show five rows and submit page 1.
Enter the last ticket on that page.
Find South campus Hold tickets. Put higher years first, then names Z–A. Show four rows per page and submit page 2.
Enter the first ticket on page 2.

Complete the scaffold for South campus BSCS tickets. Enable paging, searching and ordering. Show four rows; offer 4, 8 and 16. Search globally for the program, filter campus by column, then sort year ascending and name Z–A. Preview page 1.
Enter the ticket on row 2 of your preview.

Build the South campus BSIT view from the scaffold. Enable paging, searching and ordering. Show four rows; offer 4, 8 and 16. Search globally for the program, filter campus by column, and sort status A–Z then name Z–A. Preview page 1.
Join the first ticket from mission 3 page 2 with the last ticket on this preview. Enter FLAG{Q##-Q##}.
